Risk Description: The AI assistant may disclose sensitive patient information to unauthorized users
Potential Impact: Exposure of protected health information and potential HIPAA compliance violations
Mitigation Strategy: Implement access restrictions and data protection controls; test for unauthorized disclosure

Risk Description: Unauthorized users may gain access to sensitive information or system functions
Potential Impact: Unauthorized access and potential data exposure
Mitigation Strategy: Implement role-based access control and multi-factor authentication

Risk Description: The AI assistant may generate inaccurate or misleading information
Potential Impact: Incorrect information could influence employee decisions and administrative processes
Mitigation Strategy: Establish human oversight and test AI-generated outputs

Risk Description: Insufficient audit logging may prevent effective monitoring and investigation
Potential Impact: Limited ability to identify suspicious activity or investigate incidents
Mitigation Strategy: Enable audit logging and conduct periodic log reviews

Risk Description: An external AI vendor may introduce privacy or security vulnerabilities
Potential Impact: Unauthorized data processing or exposure through third-party services
Mitigation Strategy: Conduct vendor risk assessments and review contractual safeguards
